title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. _195 PROVIDING FOR THE CREATION OF AN INTER-AGENCY TASK FORCE FOR THE COORDINATION OF PHILIPPINE HUMANITARIAN ASSISTANCE TO IRAQ

text.en:
Composition - The Task Force shall be comprised of the following officials
(or their duly-designated representatives):
Secretary of Foreign Affairs
Secretary of National Defense
Special Envoy, Middle East Preparedness Team
Secretary of Health
Secretary of Interior and Local Government
Secretary of Social Welfare and Development
Chief of Staff, Armed Forces of the Philippine
Director-General, Philippine National Police
Executive Director, Office of Muslim Affairs
The Philippine Ambassadors to Iraq and Kuwait
Other Officials to be designated by the President
Co-Chairman
Executive Director

Role - It is recognized that international assistance to Iraq will be done in an
environment which will undergo three general stages: one, the present action led by the
Office of Reconstruction and Humanitarian Assistance (ORHA); two, the establishment of
the interim authority in Irag; and three, establishment and/or re-establishment of United
Nations assistance and related programs in Iraq.
POMA Hologram # 19312

The Task Force shall immediately formulate a consolidated plan of proposed Philippime
Assistance for the immediate needs of the Iragi nation, taking into account the evolving
assistance enviromment. Such assistance shall include:
a. Philippine participation in UN, ORHA and other humanitarian, medical and related
activities for Iraq.
b. Other relevant Philippine participation for assistance to Iraq.
The Task Force shall also perform the following functions:
a. Conclusion of arrangements with receiving/host governments whereby the
Philippine personnel contingent in Iraq are mot put at personal risk from
application of local law when deployed abroad upon orders;
b. Conduct of public information, education and communication campaign on the
hazards and risk, if amy, involved in the sending of peacekeeping/humanitarian
The Task Force shall establish a Technical Working Group to discuss in detail guidelines,
programmes and projects to accomplish the abovementioned areas of Philippine
participation in humanitarian assistance to post-war Iraq.

Separability Clause - If, for any reason, any part of this Order shall be held
unconstitutional or invalid, other parts of provisions hereof which are not affected thereby
shall continue to be in full force and effect.

Repeating Clause - All executive orders, proclamations, memorandum orders
or memorandum circulars inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity - This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon its
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14 day of April in the year of our Lord Two Thousand
POMA Hologram # 19313
By the President:
ALBERTO G. ROMULO
Executive Secretary
